images.scene: Friday crouches in the undergrowth at the foot of a tall tree and lifts up a brightly coloured parrot from the ground, holding it in both hands and turning to bring it back; Robinson stands at a distance quietly reloading his musket.
images.alt: 星期五在树下捧起被打落的鹦鹉，鲁滨逊在远处装填枪支。

images.scene: Alone in a corner of the castle enclosure, Friday sits cross-legged before the musket that leans upright against the wall, leaning close and speaking to it earnestly with his hands raised, not daring to touch it.
images.alt: 星期五独自坐在靠墙的火枪前，凑近对它说话，不敢触碰。

images.scene: At a rough wooden table Friday screws up his face and spits, washing his mouth from a bowl of fresh water after tasting salt, while Robinson sits opposite calmly eating a piece of meat from a small dish of salt.
images.alt: 星期五尝了盐后皱脸吐掉、用清水漱口，鲁滨逊在对面平静地吃肉。

images.scene: Friday kneels on a mat threshing ears of corn with a stick to knock out the grain, then shakes the loose kernels through a woven sieve so the chaff drifts away in the breeze; baskets of grain stand around him.
images.alt: 星期五跪在垫上用棍子打谷、再用筛子筛去谷壳，四周放着盛谷的篮子。

images.scene: On the sandy northwest shore Friday kneels and lays out a long row of small stones on the ground, pointing along them one by one toward Robinson, who watches; broken canoes and scattered bones lie further along the beach.
images.alt: 星期五在西北岸边跪着摆出一长排石子逐一指数，鲁滨逊在旁观看，远处沙滩有残破独木舟。

images.scene: Robinson fastens a leather belt around Friday's waist, from which a frog holds a hatchet, and hands him a knife; Friday looks down at the gifts with delight, gripping the knife in one hand.
images.alt: 鲁滨逊为星期五系上挂着斧头的腰带并递给他一把刀，星期五低头欣喜地握着刀。
